policy.unknownQueryPolicy: No gold-based or unvalidated confidence gate. Measure selection drift explicitly; do not ship on an unexplained regression.
policy.admission: Whole replacement in the existing complete rendered prompt, all-or-exact-fallback. No clipping, new source interpretation, canonical writes or model rollout.

scope: Read-only baseline-evidence guard plus fixed anchored MMR. RP264 fresh40 is now development; second fresh24 is independent. Whole-prompt probes are separate.

evidencePolicy.preserveBaselineEvidence: Every already-admitted current source with task/claim or a nonempty frozen source-role binding is mandatory. Attribution is not importance: speaker-bound discussions may conservatively fill the budget too.
evidencePolicy.seedOrder: lexical leader then mandatory baseline evidence in its existing order
evidencePolicy.overflow: If mandatory evidence fills cap8 or the mandatory union exceeds cap8, exact baseline fallback
evidencePolicy.unknownQueryPolicy: Measure explicitly; no gold-based suppression or unvalidated confidence threshold
evidencePolicy.evaluation: RP264 fresh40 is development now; author and freeze a second new24 before evaluating this guard

promptProbes.scope: Whole-block replacement probe in the actual existing full prompt. Other sections/guards are retained; no second allocator, production hook, truncated subset or live send.

budgetEvidenceAudit.scope: Post-run invariant audit of actual compiler baseline at EACH measured budget; no selection/tuning uses this audit.

environment.scope: Synthetic Node benchmark. Timings include concurrent focused unit work and are not controlled browser latency measurements.

offlineProbe.scope: Not an OS network-adapter disconnection or browser test.

sharedEncodingReplay.scope: Same exact prefixed texts/revision/quantization across two independently computed workloads; no new model download.

decision: Evidence guard prevents source loss, but second independent fresh24 has no recall gain (14/20 stays14/20), and prior unknown controls still drift. Keep isolated; no production integration.
